# Drone Craft

> Aerial art and digital media by Colin Dixon, based in Mallacoota, Victoria, Australia.

Website: https://dronecraft.au/
Portfolio: https://coota.au/
Contact: mailto:col@dixon.au
Phone: 0419 415 000
Book a conversation: https://calendly.com/colindixon

## Work
- Aerial photography of Mallacoota's coastline, lakes, beaches and changing weather.
- Cinematic drone video and visual storytelling.
- Interactive 360-degree panoramas and immersive landscape views.
- Drone platform: DJI Mavic 4 Pro.

## Identity
Colin Dixon is an aerial artist and digital strategist based in Mallacoota, Victoria.
This website is a one-page portfolio, not a directory or an online booking service.
See https://dronecraft.au/ for the authoritative site copy and current links.
